title: X-Men Cast, VisionQuest Trailer: All the Big Marvel News Out of D23 - CNET
summary: Joining Feige on stage to introduce the Avengers: Doomsday trailer were Robert Downey Jr (Victor Von Doom), Chris Evans (back as Steve Rogers) and Hayley Atwell (Peggy Carter). The star-studded trailer included Victor Von Doom easily fighting off Chris Hemsworth’s Thor.
